craft_notes: Sthāyin: Giving and receiving (audārya); gifts moving both ways. End-dash→comma (tide swells on). Rejected: 'elsewhere none' inversion — L3 order kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: While higher swells the thousandfold tide of savour,
past love-juice for thee, Lord, nowhere is it found.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yāvad uttaram āsvādasahasraguṇavistaraḥ tvadbhaktirasapīyūṣān nātha nānyatra dṛśyate
